title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along the Main Street, Center Street, Henderson Drive, Edwards Street, Trailblazer Drive, and Plaza Drive corridors in nearby Travelers Rest.

cards.title: Crêpes at Tandem
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor — sweet and savory crêpes
cards.notes: Follow the South Main Street corridor to Tandem, then choose from the documented menu of crêpes, waffles, granola, coffee, tea, or soda.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street coffeehouse with a focused all-ages food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Tandem’s official site documents sweet and savory crêpes, whole-wheat waffles, house-made granola, coffee, teas, and handcrafted sodas.
cards.access_notes: Check the business’s official site before visiting for current service information.

cards.title: Seasonal Cooking at Topsoil
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor — farm-linked seasonal menus
cards.notes: Continue along South Main Street to the historic Williams Hardware building and review Topsoil’s current seasonal menu before choosing a meal.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant connecting its changing menu with regional farms.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresh on the Menu identifies Topsoil at 13 South Main Street, inside the historic Williams Hardware store, and says its menus begin with calls to farmers.
cards.source_title: Topsoil Kitchen and Market - Fresh on the Menu
cards.access_notes: Consult the restaurant’s current reservation and service information before going.

cards.title: Open Space at Trailblazer Park
cards.subtitle: Trailblazer Drive corridor — park space and mountain views
cards.notes: Turn from the Main Street corridor onto Trailblazer Drive and use the park’s open space and shade for a walk, picnic, or reading break.
cards.short_summary: A mapped Travelers Rest park with open space near downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitGreenvilleSC’s Travelers Rest itinerary places Trailblazer Park at 235 Trailblazer Drive and documents mountain views, open space, and shade.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public destination; check city notices for closures or scheduled events.

cards.title: Local Producers at the Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Trailblazer Drive corridor — farmers and makers
cards.notes: Use the Trailblazer Drive corridor and check the market calendar first; vendors and operating dates vary with the announced season.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit seasonal market centered on regional farmers and makers.
cards.evidence_claim: The market’s official site describes a nonprofit market connecting the community with fresh food, local goods, farmers, and makers, and provides a market calendar.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal operation; consult the official market calendar for the current date and vendor schedule.

cards.title: Town History at the Museum
cards.subtitle: Edwards Street corridor — Travelers Rest local history
cards.notes: Leave Main Street for the Edwards Street corridor and check the historical society’s visit information before planning time inside the museum.
cards.short_summary: A named local-history museum documented by the city and historical society.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Travelers Rest tourist map identifies the History Museum of Travelers Rest as a point of interest, and the historical society invites visitors to its museum.
cards.access_notes: Check the historical society’s current visitor information before arrival.

cards.title: Bike Skills at Gateway Park
cards.subtitle: Henderson Drive corridor — progressive bike-skills trails
cards.notes: Take the Henderson Drive corridor to Gateway Park and match the documented progressive bike-skills elements to your experience level.
cards.short_summary: A recreation park with fields, courts, a playground, and bike features.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Travelers Rest master plan locates Gateway Park at 115 Henderson Drive and documents athletic fields, tennis courts, a playground, and a progressive Bike Skills Park.
cards.source_title: City of Travelers Rest Master Plan
cards.access_notes: Outdoor recreation conditions can change; check city notices and use equipment suited to your ability.

cards.title: Independent Shelves at As The Page Turns
cards.subtitle: Plaza Drive corridor — new arrivals and book events
cards.notes: Head to the Plaza Drive corridor, confirm the store’s newly documented address, and browse new arrivals or review its event calendar.
cards.short_summary: An independent Travelers Rest bookstore with books and scheduled gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The bookstore’s official site identifies As The Page Turns as an independent Travelers Rest bookstore, documents its move to 3 Plaza Drive, and links new arrivals and events.
cards.source_title: AsThePageTurnsBooks – As The Page Turns Books
cards.access_notes: The store reports a recent move; verify the Plaza Drive address and current opening information before leaving.

cards.title: Outdoor Gear at Sunrift Adventures
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor — outdoor outfitting stop
cards.notes: Follow the South Main Street corridor to this mapped outfitter and review current equipment or rental details directly before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Travelers Rest shop oriented toward outdoor activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Travelers Rest’s official downtown shopping page lists Sunrift Adventures among the named shops in Travelers Rest.
cards.access_notes: Verify current inventory, rental availability, eligibility requirements, and operating information directly with the business.

cards.title: Library Stop on Center Street
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor — a mapped public-library destination
cards.notes: Use the Center Street corridor to reach the mapped library, then verify current public hours and any card requirements with the library system.
cards.short_summary: A public-library destination connected to downtown by Center Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Travelers Rest bicycle plan identifies the Travelers Rest Library as a destination reached from downtown via the Center Street and Poinsett Highway corridor.
cards.source_title: City of Travelers Rest Bicycle Master Plan
cards.access_notes: Confirm current branch hours, visitor access, and borrowing requirements with the library system.

cards.title: Inclusive Play at Adventure Park
cards.subtitle: Trailblazer Drive corridor — climbing and play equipment
cards.notes: Turn onto the Trailblazer Drive corridor and use the documented all-ages play equipment responsibly, giving younger visitors room on shared features.
cards.short_summary: An all-ages playground beside Trailblazer Park and City Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Travelers Rest Here documents Adventure Park beside Trailblazer Park and City Hall, with inclusive equipment including swings, climbing structures, an obstacle course, and zip lines.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor play destination; check local notices and supervise children appropriately.

warnings: Coordinates and maps URLs are null because exact values were not independently verified from direct authoritative pages.
Several destinations have cost_status unknown because the cited sources do not directly establish admission requirements.
